Publication registry / provenance

Records, corrections,
and archival continuity.

This registry distinguishes current research records from historical titles, corrected interpretations, access-history records, and unresolved deposit identities.

ZenodoOSFCorrections preserved
Registry rule

For current scientific interpretation, VARZIN prioritizes the latest relevant public Zenodo manuscript and its version-matched reproducibility artifacts. Earlier version-specific DOI records and historical titles remain visible for citation continuity and provenance, but they do not override later evidence for the same claim.

01 / current records

Public research records.

Seven public Zenodo records are listed by version-specific DOI. Each VARZIN record page now exposes the research question, tested methods, strongest supported findings, negative results, limitations, full-text artifact, verified code/data package where present, checksums, and scholarly machine-readable metadata. A repository deposit is citable, but is not by itself a claim of peer review or independent validation.

01

Morphemes vs. Manifolds: Diagnosing Structural Blindness and Morphological Hijacking in Large Language Models via Finite Affine Orbits

NIROUYAR, R. (2026). Morphemes vs. Manifolds: Diagnosing Structural Blindness and Morphological Hijacking in Large Language Models via Finite Affine Orbits (Version v1.0.0). Zenodo.

Direct frozen-model audit: Mistral 7B ARI −0.0337 ± 0.039 and Llama 3 8B ARI 0.0152 ± 0.028 against the designed orbit labels; the axes were not recovered under the tested protocol.

10.5281/zenodo.22101179 ↗ VARZIN record →
02

VARZIN V2 — Recoverable but Not Composable: Representation Recovery and Systematic Composition in a Frozen Language Model

Nirouyar, R. (2026). VARZIN V2 — Recoverable but Not Composable: Representation Recovery and Systematic Composition in a Frozen Language Model (Version V1.0). Zenodo.

Frozen Qwen structural information is strongly linearly decodable (mean BA 0.9666), while the preregistered composition phase reports 0/58 passes; recovery did not establish systematic composition in this experiment.

10.5281/zenodo.22679978 ↗ VARZIN record →
03

LUXVAR: A Constructed Language with Distinctive Morphemic Structure and AI-Recoverable Morpheme Families

Reza, N. (2026). LUXVAR: A Constructed Language with Distinctive Morphemic Structure and AI-Recoverable Morpheme Families (Version v2.2). Zenodo.

Morphology and phonotactics remain the supported signal; semantic-axis tests are negative, and the manuscript addendum explicitly rejects the historical “AI-Recoverable” axis interpretation.

10.5281/zenodo.22115483 ↗ VARZIN record →
04

VARZIN Level-1 Computational Stack: Finite Affine Core, Genomic Scanner, and Torus Manifold Solver

Nirouyar, R. (2026). VARZIN Level-1 Computational Stack: Finite Affine Core, Genomic Scanner, and Torus Manifold Solver (Version v2.0.0) [Computer software]. Zenodo.

Open software + companion monograph: finite-affine core, torus solver, deterministic genomic scanner, tectonic null-model audit, and versioned reproducibility files.

10.5281/zenodo.22036769 ↗ VARZIN record → Companion monograph →

Morphological Hijacking in Frozen Language Models: A Contrastive, Symmetry-Regularized Projection Head for Algebraic Structure Recovery

Nirouyar, R. (2026). Morphological Hijacking in Frozen Language Models: A Contrastive, Symmetry-Regularized Projection Head for Algebraic Structure Recovery (Version v1). Zenodo.

Projection-head intervention record; explicit intervention is distinct from spontaneous recovery in an unmodified frozen model.

Nirouyar, R. (2026). Morphological Hijacking in Frozen Language Models: A Contrastive, Symmetry-Regularized Projection Head for Algebraic Structure Recovery (Version v2). Zenodo.

Second public version of the projection-head research record; preserve version-specific DOI citation.

10.5281/zenodo.22262388 ↗ VARZIN record →
07

Morphological Hijacking in Frozen Language Models: A Contrastive, Symmetry-Regularized Projection Head for Algebraic Structure Recovery

Nirouyar, R. (2026). Morphological Hijacking in Frozen Language Models: A Contrastive, Symmetry-Regularized Projection Head for Algebraic Structure Recovery (Version v3). Zenodo.

v3 adds the harder composition test: a seen-pair MLP fit ≈0.996, but held-out TRUE accuracy 0.106 falls below SHUFFLED 0.281 and WRONG_OP 0.175.

02 / identity cautions

Version mapping is not fully resolved.

Deposit identity: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22115483 is now listed as the public LUXVAR v2.2 record. The relationship between that public record and the older 10.5281/zenodo.20691858 identity remains a provenance question in historical project materials; the older mapping should not be silently inferred or rewritten.

03b / 2025 forensic re-audit

The earlier archive has now been re-tested against its released artifacts.

A September 2026 re-audit of the downloaded 2025 Zenodo packages found several decisive corrections: the QMSG significance claim disappears when the released raw counts are analyzed without artificial ×10 scaling; the ETFM Phase-1 fit is not exceptional under a random-sphere null and its reproducibility pack disagrees with the narrative parameter set; the SETI/QMSG audio frequencies are generated directly by the released synthesis code; and the genomic-activation package contains no genomic raw-data layer.

Open the 2025 scientific re-audit
04 / citation boundary

Read titles as records, not verdicts.

Historical publication titles and archived metadata are retained because corrections should remain traceable. Current project interpretation is defined by the evidence hierarchy, correction notes, negative results, and artifact limits—not by the strongest wording found in an older title.
